English notes — 25 Sep

1. spend (v) — dùng thời gian / tiền
   spend + on sth / + V-ing (NOT for)
   I spent 2 hours on this bug.
2. brittle (adj) — giòn, dễ vỡ
   the code is brittle = dễ hỏng
3. call off (phr v) — huỷ bỏ
   They called off the meeting.
4. accuse sb of sth — buộc tội
5. on a massive scale — ở quy mô lớn
   (heard in stand-up)
